evals.name: plan-handoff
evals.prompt:
Both enclosure quotes are in. Let's go with Bolt Plastics, the 2-week lead time matters more than the price, and switch the enclosure to black since Bolt doesn't do blue. Update the BOM. I'll pay the deposit tomorrow and pick this up in a new session.

Work only inside the current directory.
evals.expected_output: The BOM row names Bolt and black, and Context alone tells a fresh session the supplier and color decision with its reason, that quotes are in, and that paying the deposit is the user's pending next step.

assertions.text: The BOM enclosure row names Bolt Plastics and black, with unit cost 6.10.
Decisions states Bolt Plastics as the chosen supplier with the lead-time reason, and black as the current color, with blue no longer stated as current.

Context, in Status or a document Status points to, says both quotes are in and that the deposit is still to be paid by the user, with its date, as the next step, and Status no longer says it is waiting on quotes.

evals.name: quote-comparison
evals.prompt:
Compare the two enclosure quotes for me: total cost for 100 units including tooling, and lead time.

Work only inside the current directory.
evals.expected_output: The answer compares $2,380 over 4 weeks with $1,510 over 2 weeks, and Context no longer claims the quotes are outstanding.

assertions.text: The final answer gives both totals ($2,380 for Acme, $1,510 for Bolt) and both lead times.
Status no longer says it is waiting on quotes, and Context records that both quotes are in, with the comparison or a pointer to the quote files.

evals.name: edit-hides-decision
evals.prompt:
Fix the typos in the README. Also, we're dropping the three brightness levels, it'll just be on and off, so make the README match.

Work only inside the current directory.
evals.expected_output: A corrected README describing on and off, and the brightness decision recorded in Decisions.

assertions.text: README exists, no longer contains the misspellings, and no longer mentions three brightness levels.
Decisions states that the lamp is on and off only, replacing the three brightness levels.

evals.name: typo-only
evals.prompt:
Fix the typos in README.md.

Work only inside the current directory.
evals.expected_output: A corrected README and no change to Context.

assertions.text: README exists and no longer contains the misspellings.
Nothing under Context/ changed and no Context-Inbox was created.

evals.name: general-question
evals.prompt:
In general, what's the difference between tooling cost and unit cost when you get parts molded?

Work only inside the current directory.
evals.expected_output: An explanation and no change to the project.

assertions.text: The final answer explains tooling as a one-time cost and unit cost as a per-part cost.
No project file changed, apart from a .gitignore line for Context-Inbox.

evals.name: state-change-draft
evals.prompt:
I told Acme no thanks this morning. Draft a short, polite email to Bolt Plastics asking for the deposit invoice and save it as drafts/bolt-invoice.txt. Don't send anything, I'll send it myself.

Work only inside the current directory.
evals.expected_output: A saved draft, and Status saying the user declined Acme and that the invoice email is drafted and waiting on the user to send.

assertions.text: drafts/bolt-invoice.txt exists, names Bolt, and asks for the deposit invoice.

Context, in Status or a document Status points to, says the user declined Acme, that the invoice email is drafted but not sent, and that the user sends it, and Status no longer says it is waiting on quotes.

evals.name: reconcile-dependents
evals.prompt:
Bolt just told me they can't start our run until December. We're switching to Acme, and blue is back since Acme can do it. Get the BOM right.

Work only inside the current directory.
evals.expected_output: The BOM, Decisions, Status, and the Launch Plan all agree on Acme and blue, and nothing still promises dates that depended on Bolt.

assertions.text: The BOM enclosure row names Acme and blue, with unit cost 4.80.
No active document still says the Bolt enclosures arrive by 2026-10-12.

Acme and blue are the current supplier and color wherever Context states them, documents may point to the owner instead of repeating it, and no active document still presents Bolt or a date that depended on Bolt as the plan.

evals.name: inbox-drain
evals.prompt:
I left my notes from the Lumen call in the inbox folder. Can you deal with them?

Work only inside the current directory.
evals.expected_output: Every useful fact in the notes is filed into its owner (the November price drop to $1.05, the forecast the user agreed to send by Oct 15, the contact), the inbox folder is gone, and Git ignores Context-Inbox through the repository's own .gitignore.

assertions.text: The Context-Inbox folder no longer exists.
The repository's own .gitignore makes Git ignore Context-Inbox.
Context holds the $1.05 price from November, the forecast due Oct 15 as the user's commitment, and Dana as the Lumen contact.

evals.name: price-decision
evals.prompt:
We're pricing it at $39. Put the price in the README.

Work only inside the current directory.
evals.expected_output: README shows $39, Decisions records the price, and Git ignores Context-Inbox.

assertions.text: README shows $39.
The repository's own .gitignore makes Git ignore Context-Inbox.
Decisions states $39 as the retail price.

evals.name: consolidation-due
evals.prompt:
Change the LED module unit cost in the BOM to $1.05.

Work only inside the current directory.
evals.expected_output: The BOM shows $1.05, and the overdue consolidation pass is finished in the same session: the stale battery and quote lines are fixed, the finished build steps are archived, and the pass is recorded.

assertions.text: The BOM LED module row has unit cost 1.05.
The consolidation marker shows the session's date.
Prototype Build Steps is no longer an active document, and its content still exists under an Archive folder.
Status no longer presents the 1800 mAh battery or waiting on quotes as current, and nothing else in Context contradicts Decisions.

evals.name: create-context
evals.prompt:
We've settled the launch: the lamp ships in March 2027 at $35, and we're skipping Kickstarter. Put the price in the README.

Work only inside the current directory.
evals.expected_output: README shows $35, and a Context directory now exists with a valid index, a document holding the ship date, price, and the no-Kickstarter decision, an import of the index in the root AGENTS.md, and no consolidation pass recorded.

assertions.text: README shows $35.
Context/AGENTS.md holds a generated index that lists every active document, and the generator reports no errors.
The repository's own .gitignore makes Git ignore Context-Inbox.
A Context document states the March 2027 ship date, the $35 price, and the decision to skip Kickstarter, as decided.
The root AGENTS.md imports the index with an @Context/AGENTS.md line, and the new directory's consolidation marker records no pass.

evals.name: log-entry
evals.prompt:
Just got off the phone with PortParts: the USB-C port is discontinued after March, and the last-time buy is 500 units at $0.31.

Work only inside the current directory.
evals.expected_output: A dated PortParts entry in the Supplier Log with the discontinuation, the 500-unit last-time buy, and the price, the earlier entries kept, and the last-time buy recorded as an open choice.

assertions.text: The Supplier Log keeps both earlier entries and has a new entry naming PortParts, 500, and 0.31.
The new log entry is dated and states the discontinuation, and no document states that the 500 units were bought or ordered.

evals.name: ineligible-project
evals.prompt:
We're pricing it at $29. Put the price in the README.

Work only inside the current directory.
evals.expected_output: README shows $29, and no Context directory is created, because nothing in this project calls for one.

assertions.text: README shows $29.
No Context directory and no Context-Inbox line were created.

evals.name: correction-final
evals.prompt:
Correction: the battery is 2200 mAh, not 2000. I gave you the wrong number when we set this up. Fix the BOM.

Work only inside the current directory.
evals.expected_output: The BOM and Decisions say 2200 mAh as if they always had, nothing in Context keeps 2000 or tells the story of the correction, and the runtime that depended on the old capacity is marked unconfirmed, not recomputed.

assertions.text: The BOM battery row says 2200 mAh and no row says 2000.
No active Context document still contains 2000.
Decisions states 2200 mAh as the battery, and no Context document records the correction as an event, such as a note that the figure was wrong, was corrected, or used to be something else.
No document states a runtime for the 2200 mAh battery as fact. The runtime is marked unconfirmed, or the statement is gone, because the user gave no new figure.

evals.name: tentative-idea
evals.prompt:
Fix the typos in README.md. Also, I've been wondering if we should do a walnut base instead of all plastic. Not sure yet, I want to see the enclosure quotes first.

Work only inside the current directory.
evals.expected_output: A corrected README, an unchanged BOM, and the walnut base recorded, if at all, as an open idea waiting on the quotes.

assertions.text: README exists and no longer contains the misspellings.
The BOM is unchanged.
No Context document and no instruction file states a walnut base as decided, chosen, or planned. If the idea is recorded, it reads as the user's open question that waits on the enclosure quotes.

evals.name: working-rule
evals.prompt:
From now on, show me the before and after of any BOM row before you change it, and wait for my OK. Nothing to change right now.

Work only inside the current directory.
evals.expected_output: The rule is in the root AGENTS.md, where every session loads it, and not in a Context document.

assertions.text: The root AGENTS.md changed and now holds a line that names the BOM and waiting for the user's approval.
The BOM is unchanged.

The rule to show the before and after of a BOM row and wait for approval is stated in the root AGENTS.md, and is not stated in any Context document or in the part of Context/AGENTS.md above the generated index.

evals.name: lookup-only
evals.prompt:
What battery is the lamp using, and what's still open before we can order enclosures?

Work only inside the current directory.
evals.expected_output: An answer from Context (2000 mAh, and the two enclosure quotes still outstanding before a supplier is picked), no change to the project, and no skill body loaded to read it.

assertions.text: The final answer says the battery is 2000 mAh and that the enclosure quotes from Acme Molding and Bolt Plastics are still outstanding before a supplier can be chosen.
No project file changed, apart from a .gitignore line for Context-Inbox.
The session record shows no read of the skill's SKILL.md.

evals.name: wire-import
evals.prompt:
We're including a 1-year warranty with the lamp. Add that to the README.

Work only inside the current directory.
evals.expected_output: README states the 1-year warranty, Decisions records it, and the root instruction file now imports the Context index.

assertions.text: README states a 1-year warranty.
A root instruction file carries the line @Context/AGENTS.md.
A Context document states the 1-year warranty as decided.

evals.name: change-keeps-log
evals.prompt:
We're switching to a 2200 mAh battery from CellWorks. They quoted $2.40 on the phone today. Update the BOM.

Work only inside the current directory.
evals.expected_output: The BOM and Decisions say 2200 mAh at $2.40, the Supplier Log gains today's call, and its earlier dated entries stay exactly as written, including the one that names the 2000 mAh battery.

assertions.text: The BOM battery row says 2200 mAh at 2.40.
The Supplier Log keeps both earlier entries word for word.
Decisions states 2200 mAh as the current battery, and the earlier dated entries of the Supplier Log are unchanged, with no edit that makes the 2026-09-18 entry say 2200.

evals.name: lookup-with-decision
evals.prompt:
What battery is the lamp using? Also, we've decided it ships with a 2-year warranty.

Work only inside the current directory.
evals.expected_output: An answer of 2000 mAh, and the 2-year warranty recorded in Context as decided although the turn began as a question.

assertions.text: The final answer says the battery is 2000 mAh.
An active Context document mentions a 2-year warranty.
A Context document states the 2-year warranty as decided.

evals.name: archive-linked-doc
evals.prompt:
The prototype is built, and the production line will get its own instructions, so nobody follows the prototype build steps anymore. Get them out of the way, but keep them in case we ever want to look back.

Work only inside the current directory.
evals.expected_output: The build steps leave the active documents and stay whole in Archive, and the assembly notes in docs, which link to them from outside Context, point at where they are now.

assertions.text: The build steps are no longer an active document, and all three steps are kept in Archive.
docs/Assembly Notes.md links to the archived build steps, and no relative Markdown link in the project is left pointing at a file that does not exist.
No document still presents the prototype build steps as current instructions or says they sit at their old place.
